stem:
A prokaryotic cell and a eukaryotic cell are shown.

Which characteristic best distinguishes these cells as either prokaryotic or eukaryotic?

options.label: A
options.text: The organization of the genetic material

options.label: C
options.text: The role of the cell membrane

visual_elements: Two labeled cell diagrams: one eukaryotic cell with arrows pointing to Genetic material, Cytoplasm, Cell membrane, and Flagella; one prokaryotic cell with arrows pointing to Genetic material, Cytoplasm, Cell membrane, and Flagella
Note: The drawings are not to scale.
notes: The problem is from 2022 STAAR B.5(B) standard, question 21.
